sections.h2: How Do Saudi Buyers Use AI Search?
sections.intro: Saudi Arabia is young, mobile-first and quick to adopt new technology. Several patterns shape how we plan AI search optimisation KSA campaigns:

items.html: Arabic and English prompts: consumers often ask in Arabic, while B2B buyers and expatriates often ask in English. Many people switch between the two.
Dialect and spelling: Arabic prompts vary between formal Arabic and Najdi or Hijazi wording, so we test several versions of key questions.
Shortlists: buyers ask for "top", "best" or "most trusted" options, then visit only those websites.
City detail: prompts often name Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam or Khobar, or districts such as Olaya.

outro.text: This means ChatGPT visibility Saudi Arabia brands need depends on clear Arabic and English content, local facts and a strong reputation across Saudi websites. Vision 2030 projects, new giga-project suppliers and fast-growing sectors such as tourism, entertainment and fintech are also creating many new buyer questions, which gives early movers a real advantage.

sections.h2: What We Do to Get Saudi Brands Cited

items.title: Entity Data Clean-Up
items.text: We align your company name in Arabic and English, Commercial Registration details, services, branches and leadership across your website, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn and Saudi directories. Inconsistent Arabic and English names are one of the most common reasons AI engines confuse Saudi brands.

items.title: Quotable Bilingual Content
items.text: We add short answer blocks, FAQs, price ranges in SAR and dated results to key pages in both languages, with schema markup that tells engines exactly what each page covers. We write in plain language, so answers are easy to quote word for word.

items.title: Arabic Content That AI Engines Understand
items.text: Many Saudi websites have strong English pages but thin or machine-translated Arabic pages. AI engines then answer Arabic prompts using other sources, or describe your services incorrectly. We review your Arabic pages, fill gaps with clear, native-quality content and make sure key facts, such as services, cities, prices and credentials, match in both languages.

items.title: Crawler Access
items.text: We check that AI crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot can read your public pages, and verify your site in Bing Webmaster Tools because some assistants draw on Bing's index.

items.title: Third-Party Mentions
items.text: We help you earn mentions on the Saudi sources AI engines trust, explained in detail below.

sections.h2: Entity Data, Reviews and Press Mentions
sections.intro: AI answers often repeat what trusted Saudi sources say about you. The most useful include:

items.html: Business directories: chamber of commerce listings, industry directories, Clutch and GoodFirms.
Reviews: Google reviews in Arabic and English, plus sector platforms for clinics, restaurants and hotels.
Press: Saudi business news sites, sector magazines and Arabic media.
Events and awards: conference speaker lists, exhibitor pages and recognised awards.
Your own experts: articles, interviews and LinkedIn posts by your leaders, which show real experience and give AI engines quotable, attributed facts.

outro.text: We plan, pitch and update these sources so AI engines find the same accurate story about your brand everywhere. We also correct old listings with wrong phone numbers or closed branches, which AI assistants may still repeat, and we make sure your Arabic company name is spelled the same way everywhere.
